about: In the scorched wasteland, speed is all that matters!
Tired of feeling sick playing racing VR Games?
Apocalypse Rider is a VR arcade motorcycle game where you must prevail the high-speed wasteland roads, avoid the hostile traffic and keep surviving, speeding and RIDING!
* 5+ motorcycles available with dozens of upgrades
PlayStation®VR and PlayStation®Camera is required to play this product
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation Network is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
